description: Minimal isolated workspace for the integrated robotic handling engineering benchmark.

files.content:
# Integrated robotic handling benchmark workspace

This workspace intentionally contains no candidate solution and no other model output. Open the live-verified RotorBench launch URL supplied by the operator, verify its declared hashes, and place the complete handoff under `candidate-output/`.

# Candidate output

Create `plan.json` first and follow the exact v4 checkpoint, artifact, and submission contracts in the live launch prompt. This directory is the only handoff boundary.

# Candidate templates

Copy these templates into `candidate-output/` before use. Replace every placeholder with facts from the live `launch.json`; in particular copy the complete frozen `v4Contract` object exactly. The templates do not replace the frozen schemas, task packet, or artifact contract. Run `node tools/stage1-preflight.mjs` against the hash-verified output contract before sealing a checkpoint.
